moments.title: F1 Hungarian Grand Prix
moments.blurb: The Formula 1 AWS Hungarian Grand Prix is taking place today at the Hungaroring, with Lando Norris on pole position.

angles.name: Race Day Excitement
angles.copy: Lights out, and away we go! It's Grand Prix race day in Hungary, with Lando Norris starting from pole. Can he hold on for the win?

angles.name: Norris' Pole Position
angles.copy: Lando Norris on pole for today's Hungarian Grand Prix! All eyes on the Brit to convert that into a victory. Tune in!

moments.title: The Hundred Continues: Manchester vs Birmingham

angles.name: Match Day Action

moments.title: Mick Jagger turns 83

angles.name: Still Rocking at 83
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the one and only Mick Jagger! The ultimate rock 'n' roll icon, still strutting and captivating audiences worldwide. What's your favourite Stones track?

angles.name: Legendary Performer
angles.copy: From Hyde Park to stadiums across the globe, Mick Jagger has been electrifying stages for decades. Wishing the legend a very happy 83rd birthday!

angles.name: Drumming Legend
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the one and only Roger Taylor! The man behind the thunderous drums for Queen, and a brilliant songwriter in his own right. What's your favourite Queen song he wrote?

angles.name: Queen's Beat
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 77th birthday to Roger Taylor! The legendary drummer who gave Queen their iconic beat. What's your top Queen track?
